info.name: LEAD-308 / LEAD-407 Adviser AC Verification
info.description: Generated from the frozen LEAD-308 v2 Contract collection. Numeric prefixes make the requests traceable in the shared Newman report pipeline.

item.name: 01 Library Bootstrap
item.description: The three read requests used when Adviser Template Library first opens.

request.description: Category tree nodes return the static publishedTemplateCount for all Published Templates. Counts are calculated by unique emailCode and do not change with Search or Tag filters.

exec: pm.test('HTTP status is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
let json = {};
pm.test('Response is JSON', function () { json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json).to.be.an('object'); });

pm.test('IIC response envelope exists', function () { pm.expect(json).to.have.property('requestId'); pm.expect(json).to.have.property('responseCode'); pm.expect(json).to.have.property('responseMessage'); pm.expect(json).to.have.property('data'); });
pm.test('Business response is successful', function () { pm.expect(json.responseCode).to.eql('00000000'); });
pm.test('Response time is below 10 seconds', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(10000); });
pm.test('Category tree exists', function () { pm.expect(json.data).to.be.an('array'); });

pm.test('Category tree exposes static published counts', function () { function check(nodes) { (nodes || []).forEach(function (node) { pm.expect(node.publishedTemplateCount).to.be.a('number'); check(node.children); }); } check(json.data); });

pm.test('Category IDs are JavaScript-safe strings', function () { (json.data || []).forEach(function (parent) { pm.expect(parent.id).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(String(parent.parentId)).to.eql('0'); pm.expect(parent.children).to.be.an('array'); parent.children.forEach(function (child) { pm.expect(child.id).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(String(child.parentId)).to.eql(String(parent.id)); }); }); });

const parent = (json.data || []).find(function (item) { return item.children?.length; }) || (json.data || [])[0]; if (parent?.id) { pm.collectionVariables.set('categoryId', String(parent.id)); const child = (parent.children || [])[0]; if (child?.id) pm.collectionVariables.set('subcategoryId', String(child.id)); }

item.name: 102 NEW-06 Tag Taxonomy - Four Mandatory Groups

request.description: LEAD-308 Adviser UI uses only CONTENT_TYPE, TRIGGER, LIFECYCLE_STAGE and FINANCIAL_NEED; Optional groups are not displayed or filtered.

exec: pm.test('HTTP status is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
let json = {};
pm.test('Response is JSON', function () { json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json).to.be.an('object'); });

pm.test('IIC response envelope exists', function () { pm.expect(json).to.have.property('requestId'); pm.expect(json).to.have.property('responseCode'); pm.expect(json).to.have.property('responseMessage'); pm.expect(json).to.have.property('data'); });
pm.test('Business response is successful', function () { pm.expect(json.responseCode).to.eql('00000000'); });
pm.test('Response time is below 10 seconds', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(10000); });

pm.test('Four LEAD-308 mandatory groups exist', function () { const codes = (json.data || []).map(function (group) { return group.groupCode; }); ['CONTENT_TYPE','TRIGGER','LIFECYCLE_STAGE','FINANCIAL_NEED'].forEach(function (code) { pm.expect(codes).to.include(code); }); });

const group = (json.data || []).find(function (item) { return ['CONTENT_TYPE','TRIGGER','LIFECYCLE_STAGE','FINANCIAL_NEED'].includes(item.groupCode) && item.tagValues?.length; }); if (group) { pm.collectionVariables.set('tagGroupCode', String(group.groupCode)); pm.collectionVariables.set('tagCode', String(group.tagValues[0].tagCode)); }

item.name: 103 EX-01 Published List - Email Adviser Cards

request.description: Base LEAD-308 card query. LEAD-93 v2 fixes is_campaign=0; Adviser does not send or consume isCampaign.

exec: pm.test('HTTP status is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
let json = {};
pm.test('Response is JSON', function () { json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json).to.be.an('object'); });

pm.test('IIC response envelope exists', function () { pm.expect(json).to.have.property('requestId'); pm.expect(json).to.have.property('responseCode'); pm.expect(json).to.have.property('responseMessage'); pm.expect(json).to.have.property('data'); });
pm.test('Business response is successful', function () { pm.expect(json.responseCode).to.eql('00000000'); });
pm.test('Response time is below 10 seconds', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(10000); });

pm.test('Page response exists', function () { pm.expect(json.data).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(json.data.pageNo).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(json.data.pageSize).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(json.data.totalCount).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(json.data.totalPage).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(json.data.dataList).to.be.an('array'); });

pm.test('Every returned Template is Active Published', function () { (json.data.dataList || []).forEach(function (row) { pm.expect(Number(row.versionStatus)).to.eql(1); pm.expect(Number(row.emailStatus)).to.eql(1); pm.expect(String(row.emailCode)).to.match(/^\d+$/); }); });

const first = (json.data.dataList || [])[0]; if (first?.emailCode) { pm.collectionVariables.set('emailCode', String(first.emailCode)); if (first.emailName) pm.collectionVariables.set('searchKeyword', String(first.emailName)); if (first.categoryId) pm.collectionVariables.set('categoryId', String(first.categoryId)); const sub = (first.subCategoryIds || [])[0]; if (sub) pm.collectionVariables.set('subcategoryId', String(sub)); const groups = first.tagMap || {}; const groupCode = Object.keys(groups).find(function (code) { return ['CONTENT_TYPE','TRIGGER','LIFECYCLE_STAGE','FINANCIAL_NEED'].includes(code) && (groups[code] || []).length; }); if (groupCode) { pm.collectionVariables.set('tagGroupCode', groupCode); pm.collectionVariables.set('tagCode', String(groups[groupCode][0])); } }
